div.div:
أَشْهَلُ , applied to a man, (S, O,) Having that quality of the eye which is termed شُهْلَةٌ: (S, O, K:) accord. to AZ, syn. with أَشْكَلُ: (TA: [but see this latter epithet:]) fem. شَهْلَآءُ; (K;) which is applied as an epithet to an eye. (S, O.) ―
-b2- Also A mountain, and a wolf, dust-coloured inclining to whiteness. (En-Nadr, TA.) ―
-b3- And الأَشْهَلُ is the name of A certain idol. (Ibn-El-Kelbee, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
